hypotheses.mechanism: Event-log-only alternatives: delete persistent branch state entirely; store common base plus branch event suffix and reconstruct on demand.
hypotheses.expected_gain: minimal persistent storage when branch reads are rare
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: snapshot+overlay caches avoid replay cost with little extra complexity
hypotheses.falsifier: materialization/read cost dominates sparse overlay at modest branch depth
hypotheses.minimum_test: vary read frequency and event depth
failure_modes: nonexistent historical cognition synthesis if event semantics are not exact
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current semantics permit alternatives but do not specify log-only physical representation

hypotheses.mechanism: Possibility State Weave (PSW): immutable common base + branch guards + sparse field deltas + exact branch identity/provenance + read-set-aware shared pure-transition lifting.
hypotheses.problem_target: store and process many mostly-identical alternatives
hypotheses.expected_gain: storage near O(F+Nd) and fewer repeated pure transition executions
hypotheses.counterprediction: metadata/guard overhead removes benefit or semantics collapse to known variational execution
hypotheses.falsifier: no unique Pareto region versus strongest conventional baseline
hypotheses.minimum_test: branch count × divergence × read/write distribution benchmark
failure_modes: illegal sharing across semantically distinct branches
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: no current Hyperposition representation-level shared-state execution contract found

hypotheses.mechanism: Content-addressed branch DAG: every immutable state node is hash-consed and branch heads point into a Merkle DAG.
hypotheses.expected_gain: automatic exact deduplication and durable identity
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: persistent map already structurally shares paths
hypotheses.counterprediction: hashing and node indirection dominate small cognitive states
hypotheses.falsifier: higher memory/latency than path-copy persistent baseline
failure_modes: semantic equality conflated with evidence-lineage equality
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current DB lineage does not imply branch-state DAG realization

hypotheses.mechanism: Field-wise guarded values: one record; only divergent fields carry condition->value maps.
hypotheses.expected_gain: excellent compression when few fields diverge across many worlds
hypotheses.counterprediction: condition maps explode under correlated multi-field branching
hypotheses.falsifier: guard storage or read cost exceeds sparse per-branch overlays
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Hyperposition semantics do not currently require field-wise guarded encoding

hypotheses.mechanism: Lazy fork on first discriminating read: branch labels exist logically, but physical state forks only when a transition reads a divergent coordinate.
hypotheses.expected_gain: avoid work for alternatives that never become behaviorally distinct
hypotheses.counterprediction: read-set tracking cost exceeds saved execution
hypotheses.falsifier: no transition-op savings on realistic mixed read sets
hypotheses.minimum_test: branching with shared and discriminating pure operations
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: no current cross-branch execution lifting contract

hypotheses.mechanism: Causal influence slicing: only fields downstream of a branch-specific causal difference are allowed to diverge; unaffected descendants stay shared.
hypotheses.expected_gain: sharing follows causal relevance rather than syntactic branch identity
hypotheses.counterprediction: dependence tracking is more expensive than recomputation
hypotheses.minimum_test: known dependency graph with sparse causal branches
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: causal credit exists for outcomes but not physical branch sharing

hypotheses.mechanism: Observational quotienting: alternatives whose future permitted observations/actions are equivalent under current query set share one representative plus multiplicity/provenance set.
hypotheses.expected_gain: collapse large alternative sets without declaring truth equivalence
hypotheses.counterprediction: query-set changes invalidate quotient and require expensive split
hypotheses.falsifier: false merge or rebuild cost dominates
hypotheses.minimum_test: dynamic observation alphabet with known equivalence classes
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: no explicit observational quotient contract found

hypotheses.mechanism: Adaptive representation selector: dynamically choose full-copy, overlay, guarded-value or PSW based on measured branch count, divergence density and read/write profile.
hypotheses.problem_target: no single representation wins all regimes
hypotheses.expected_gain: Pareto envelope rather than one universal structure
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: hand-tuned threshold or always persistent map
hypotheses.falsifier: static best baseline beats adaptive across distribution
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: no measured representation envelope currently attached to Hyperposition

hypotheses.mechanism: Genome-style branch encoding: common state is a reference genome; each possibility stores a sparse variant call set and phase/lineage information; recombination/merge is prohibited unless lineage-compatible.
hypotheses.problem_target: many mostly-identical worlds with sparse mutations and provenance
hypotheses.expected_gain: borrow mature sparse-variant semantics including reference-relative encoding and phased alternatives
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: ordinary sparse overlay is isomorphic without biological terminology
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: not present; likely semantic analogy only

hypotheses.mechanism: Quantum-circuit-inspired deferred measurement: represent branch transformations symbolically until a Clay query/effect boundary requires a concrete branch observation, then materialize only the measured projection.
hypotheses.counterprediction: collapses completely to standard symbolic execution
hypotheses.falsifier: no distinct semantics beyond symbolic expressions
hypotheses.minimum_test: symbolic arithmetic/state updates versus lazy baseline

hypotheses.mechanism: Particle subset: keep only weighted sampled possibilities rather than exhaustive alternatives.
hypotheses.expected_gain: bounded memory independent of total hypothesis count
hypotheses.falsifier: rare-critical recall failure under matched memory
hypotheses.minimum_test: heavy-tail hypothesis distribution with critical rare branch
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Hyperposition semantics preserve unresolved alternatives rather than probabilistically discard them by default

hypotheses.mechanism: SIMD-over-worlds transition lifting: vectorize identical pure ClayCode operations across branches while masking divergent inputs.
hypotheses.expected_gain: throughput gain even when state compression is modest
hypotheses.counterprediction: branch masks and small branch counts eliminate benefit
hypotheses.falsifier: no throughput win against batched materialized worlds
hypotheses.minimum_test: pure transition kernels across N alternatives
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current runtime has no multi-world vectorization contract

hypotheses.mechanism: Branch-epoch braid: base epoch plus per-branch monotone revision and provenance root; collapse requires exact current base and branch lineage, preventing ABA-style reattachment after restart.
hypotheses.problem_target: stale branch reuse and semantic merge after state changes
hypotheses.counterprediction: no unique benefit beyond current epoch/provenance discipline
hypotheses.falsifier: generation counter baseline catches all modeled stale/replay faults
hypotheses.minimum_test: ABA branch-id reuse and stale-collapse injection
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current branch consumer constraints require this property but exact representation is not fixed

hypotheses.mechanism: Factorized possibility graph: alternatives are not world branches at all; uncertain variables are factors and only a query constructs compatible partial worlds.
hypotheses.problem_target: cross-product explosion when uncertainties are mostly independent
hypotheses.expected_gain: represent k independent uncertainties additively rather than product of alternatives
hypotheses.counterprediction: cross-factor constraints make inference more costly than sparse world overlays
hypotheses.falsifier: query/reconstruction cost or constraint explosion exceeds explicit-world baseline
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: current semantics speak in unresolved alternatives, not factorized uncertainty variables
